items.method: Cross-read the single-name options tape (call-versus-put premium, call fraction and the strike and days-to-expiry of the heaviest same-session prints) against the dealer-positioning corridor (positive dealer gamma, flip, put and call walls, front expected move, pin-to-maxpain playbook), the intraday auction state and cash-market breadth, then judge whether outright put-heavy premium meeting a positive-gamma pin that spot has decayed down onto — with the auction now trending lower — is a downside break beginning or a hedge flow still being absorbed by a long-gamma pin, and anchor a direction-correct invalidation ABOVE spot at the reclaim that would falsify the downside-pressure caution.
items.note: The genuinely new signature this window is that the single-name derivative tape has moved past balanced and turned outright put-heavy at the same moment spot has decayed down onto the gamma flip and the intraday auction has flipped to a down-trend day. Aggregate premium is a 0.3709 call fraction — $1.544B of call premium against $2.619B of put premium across 12 tickers, with 1755 contracts clearing the $250k bar inside 30 days (474 of 19178 considered). The heaviest same-session prints are defensive and near-dated: an IWM 298 put at $8.3M on 8.18x its open interest zero days out, a TSLA 350 put at $51.2M on 17.76x open interest zero days out, and a GOOGL 345 call at $7.5M on 5.40x open interest — two large index-and-single-name downside hedges outweighing the one upside print. This lands on a positive dealer-gamma structure, but unlike a mid-corridor pin the spot has come down to it: SPY is 769.41, essentially on the 769.01 flip and just beneath the 770 call wall, inside a plus-or-minus 4.56 front expected move, with signed net GEX around +0.42B and the gamma playbook reading pin-to-maxpain with a same-session-fade hold. Long-gamma dealers still damp realized moves, but the intraday tape is now a Trend day · down under Mixed control (VWAP 771.61, +0.09% gap, 62 bars), so the pin is being tested from above rather than held in the middle. Cash breadth is collapsed — market-heatmap breadth is only 17.88% of 134 constituents positive, a 42.12-point miss of the 60% broad-participation line — so the tape rests on a shrinking cohort. Put-heavy near-dated premium pressing a flip-level pin under a down-trend auction and collapsed breadth is a rally-quality caution weighted to the downside. Watch a decisive loss of the 769.01 flip and the 765 put wall as the confirming trigger that the pin fails downward and dealers flip toward selling weakness; the downside-pressure caution is invalidated on a daily close above ~772.00 on SPY, which clears the 770 call wall, reasserts the long-gamma grind and shows the put premium was absorbed rather than leading.
items.title: Single-name option premium has turned outright put-heavy (0.3709 call fraction, $1.544B calls vs $2.619B puts across 12 names, 1755 contracts clearing the $250k bar inside 30 days) into a positive-gamma pin that spot has decayed down onto — SPY sits at 769.41 right on the 769.01 flip and just beneath the 770 call wall while the auction reads Trend day · down, the heaviest prints are an IWM 298 put at $8.3M on 8.18x open interest and a TSLA 350 put at $51.2M on 17.76x open interest both zero days out, and cash breadth is only 17.88% of 134 constituents

items.method: Cross-read the deteriorating US internals (collapsed market-heatmap breadth, put-heavy single-name premium, a down-trend intraday auction) against where leadership is actually being scored — the global-rotation composite (Singapore, Taiwan, Germany ahead of the US-heavy ACWI) and the real-assets 0-100 composite (crypto and broad commodities leading, monetary metals lagging) — to test whether risk appetite has migrated offshore and into real assets even as the domestic tape weakens, then, finding the leadership cluster resolves to relative-strength scores and composite rankings rather than any single committed-universe price level, withhold a tactical call rather than publish one that cannot be scored.
items.note: The second cross-model pattern this window is a migration of leadership away from the weakening domestic tape rather than a confirmation of it. The US internals are soft together: market-heatmap breadth is only 17.88% of 134 constituents positive (a 42.12-point miss of the 60% line), single-name option premium is put-heavy at a 0.3709 call fraction ($2.619B puts versus $1.544B calls), and the intraday auction is a Trend day · down under Mixed control with VWAP 771.61. Yet the leadership scores point outward and into real assets. Global rotation ranks EWS (Singapore) first at 89.2/100 versus the US-heavy ACWI, with EWT (Taiwan) 77, EWG (Germany) 69.2 and EWC (Canada) 66.4 ahead of a middling US read, and the Singapore leg is a local-equity-led move with an FX drag rather than a dollar tailwind. Real assets are led by crypto and broad commodities — ETH-USD 76.9, agriculture DBA 70.9, bitcoin (BTC-USD) 69.1, DBC 68.3 (six-month momentum +22.75%) and PDBC 68.2 — while the defensive monetary metals lag badly: gold (GLD) 37.9 with six-month momentum -15.53% and silver (SLV) 16.9 with -29.46%, and oil (USO) 57.7 sits in the middle on a flat +0.39% three-month pulse. Offshore-equity and speculative real-asset leadership with lagging gold and silver, set against a defensive US sector rotation that still leans on discretionary (XLY Basing higher, accel +1.14) with healthcare the named leader (XLV) as energy weakens (XLE, accel -0.17), is a where-is-the-bid observation, not a scoreable trade: the cluster resolves to relative-strength states and 0-100 composite scores, none of which is a single committed-universe instrument with a direction-correct price trigger this window, so a tactical call is withheld rather than published with only a working side. Watch whether US breadth reclaims the 60% participation line to close the gap with the offshore and real-asset leadership, or whether the down-trend domestic tape drags the composite reads lower; until an instrument-level price trigger is in view, the cluster is carried as counter-weight context to the index-level downside-pressure caution, not as its own call.
items.title: Leadership has migrated offshore and into real assets while US internals weaken under a collapsed 17.88% breadth — global rotation ranks Singapore (EWS 89.2), Taiwan (EWT 77) and Germany (EWG 69.2) ahead of the US-heavy ACWI, and real assets are led by crypto and broad commodities (ETH-USD 76.9, DBA 70.9, BTC-USD 69.1, DBC 68.3, PDBC 68.2) with gold (GLD 37.9, six-month momentum -15.53%) and silver (SLV 16.9, -29.46%) lagging, a cross-model migration that resolves to no single committed-universe price level
